target_definition: 1 if German load 24 hours ahead is at or above the 80th percentile of observed 24-hour-ahead load (65811.8 MW).
carbon_proxy_note: The carbon variable is a residual-load proxy, not a measured German grid-emission inventory. It scales from 150 to 650 gCO2e/kWh as the load share unmet by observed wind and solar increases.
